messages:
Aisha R.: heads-up: deploy-bot triggered an auto-revert suggestion for canary v3.6.1 in us-west due to regression in throughput. change window is open but we have active customer demos in 30m.
Leo M.: what's the metric? deploy-bot summary?
deploy-bot: SUGGESTED ACTION: automatic revert -> target stable-2026-03; reason: throughput_drop>20% and increased 5xx rate. auto-reverts disabled during change_window(20:00-21:00 UTC). To force: /deploy revert --force (ops-only).
Jun (oncall): interesting — auto was suppressed. I can force if we decide. can we do a staged drain instead (stop new deployments) and pin traffic for 50% to stable?
Aisha R.: prefer manual staged revert. demos worry me. if we hold for 15m and metric doesn't improve, we revert. can Jun coordinate?
Leo M.: I want to try a targeted revert for the serving runtime flag that changed: `--fast-alloc` was enabled in v3.6.1. If we flip it off (variant v3.6.1-slowalloc) we might recover without full revert. ops supports per-flag routing.
Jun (oncall): agree. plan: 1) flip to v3.6.1-slowalloc in us-west (100%) at t+5m, 2) monitor throughput and 5xx for 10m, 3) if no improvement revert to stable-2026-03. I'll post status every 5m.
Marta (docs): I'll prepare a one-liner for release-notes and a short blurb for release-change-log: "Applied targeted flag rollback in us-west to address transient throughput regression in v3.6.1; monitoring ongoing."
Aisha R.: Jun, also do a quick smoke test for the customer demo endpoints after the change. who owns customer comms if we need to send a note?
Leo M.: Sales/CS notified automatically by the integrations but we should pre-draft a short message. Legal Bot: Reminder: any customer-facing incident note must be cleared by Legal for regulated customers. ~30-60m review expected.
Jun (oncall): executing now: `/deploy route --region=us-west --target=v3.6.1-slowalloc --percent=100` -> in progress.
deploy-bot: ACTION: manual-route logged by Jun at 20:05 UTC.
Jun (oncall): initial smoke tests OK (login, basic inference). throughput trending up at 2m mark. 5xx rate dropped from 1.9% -> 0.3%.
Aisha R.: good. hold for 10m then reassess. if stable, we'll avoid a full revert and just ship a patch to remove the allocator change. Leo, can you file a quick INF ticket for the patch and link traces?
Leo M.: filed INF-4322 with traces and suggested patch (disable fast alloc by default for services with <1M RPS).
Marta (docs): release-notes PR: "Mitigated throughput regression by pinning us-west to v3.6.1-slowalloc; customers unaffected. Follow-up patch planned (INF-4322)." opening PR now.
Aisha R.: adding a note: do not let deploybot autoforce revert during change_window unless paging threshold hit. Jun, if metrics regress again, escalate to oncall and we'll force revert.
Jun (oncall): copied. will alert if 5xx >1% sustained for 3m.
Aisha R.: thanks team — nice coordinated manual fallback. will update slack thread when we decide final action.
Leo M.: +1, and we should add a checklist to the release playbook about change_window-suppression behavior for deploy-bot. Marta, can you add to docs?
Marta (docs): will add a short section under release-runbook: "When change_window suppresses auto actions, prefer targeted flag pinning before full revert; ensure customer comms ready." PR incoming.
Aisha R.: closing for now — last update expected at 20:15 UTC.
